title: Pan-Seared Pork Chops
description: A classic Canadian dish featuring tender pork chops and a silky pan sauce. Perfect for a hearty meal.
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt, pepper, and herbs.
Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the olive oil to the skillet and swirl to coat.
Sear the pork chops for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven.
Bake the pork chops for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Remove the pork chops from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and garlic.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the pork chops and serve.
Serve the pork chops with the pan sauce spooned over the top.
